data.exact_reserve_text: The movement in the gross provision for claims includes a release of GBP 8.7m in respect of claims outstanding at the previous year end (2013 - GBP 4.9m). Included in this favorable development of prior accident years is a GBP 2.6m reduction in the estimated ultimate loss related to Storm Sandy, GBP 3.5m reduction in the estimated ultimate loss related to other large and small catastrophe events and GBP 2.6m favorable development of prior accident years related to attritional gross claims and claim expenses principally due to reported claims activity coming in lower than expected on prior accident year events.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded a gross favourable prior year development (release) of GBP 8.7m on claims outstanding versus the prior year. This release was driven principally by reductions in estimated ultimate losses on prior catastrophe events (including a GBP 2.6m reduction for Storm Sandy and a GBP 3.5m reduction for other large and small catastrophe events) together with GBP 2.6m of favourable development on attritional claims and claim expenses as reported claims emerged lower than expected. The movement primarily affected the property-related business and contributed to a ~6.8% reduction relative to opening gross claims outstanding.
raw_causal_phrases: The movement in the gross provision for claims includes a release of GBP 8.7m in respect of claims outstanding at the previous year end (2013 - GBP 4.9m).

Included in this favorable development of prior accident years is a GBP 2.6m reduction in the estimated ultimate loss related to Storm Sandy, GBP 3.5m reduction in the estimated ultimate loss related to other large and small catastrophe events and GBP 2.6m favorable development of prior accident years related to attritional gross claims and claim expenses principally due to reported claims activity coming in lower than expected on prior accident year events.
The Syndicate's losses for the year largely comprise attritional claims and claim expenses, principally as IBNR, on the Syndicate non-property catastrophe reinsurance and insurance business.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development (GBP 8.7m) is taken from the narrative in the Claims outstanding note (gross figure). The narrative itemises components (Storm Sandy GBP 2.6m, other catastrophes GBP 3.5m, attritional GBP 2.6m) which are used to allocate a portion to Property; other LOB allocations are not quantified. Named current-year events (Hurricane Odile, US crop hail) are mentioned but not quantified. No gross claims development triangle was present in the provided pages, and no RITC distortion was indicated.
